{{Quote|All I can tell you, is I have scanned Master Yoda three times and I find nothing wrong with him. I am not an expert on his biology, but from my point of view, he is in perfect health.|Doctor Rig Nema|<ref name="Voices" />}}
'''Rig Nema''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] stationed in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She took care of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] when the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] started to hear the disembodied voice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] about [[32 BBY/Legends|twelve years earlier]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I am prescribing nothing but bed rest for you now, Master Yoda.|Doctor Rig Nema|<ref name="Voices" />}}
Rig Nema, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Voices" />

[[File:NemaKenobiYoda.png|thumb|left|260px|Doctor Nema, along with Obi-Wan Kenobi, is watching over Yoda.]]
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="SWDS">''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Death Sentence]]''</ref> Doctor Nema received [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] as a patient. The other members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] were worried about Yoda's behavior after he revealed to them that he heard the voice of the late [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] thought that it was some trick created by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to infiltrate and strike a blow against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Voices" />

Nema found that Yoda was in good health, but also noticed that a region of his [[Brain/Legends|brain]] was particularly active. Master Mundi expressed his concern once again, telling [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that the deep connection between Yoda and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]&mdash;who used to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the Grand Master&mdash;could have allowed the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to manipulate Yoda's mind.<ref name="Voices" />

[[File:DeprivationRitual.png|thumb|right|220px|The deprivation ritual]]
Doctor Nema suggested to put Yoda through a [[Deprivation ritual/Legends|deprivation ritual]], so he could find the real source of the voice he heard. Yoda was subsequently brought into a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], progressively deprived of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], so he could enter a deep [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] state, while on the brink of [[Death/Legends|death]]. When that happened, Jinn's spirit communicated with Yoda once more and advised him to travel to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="Voices" />

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] later helped Yoda escape the Jedi Temple before Doctor Nema could notice his absence. She and Mace Windu arrived too late to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] to stop the fleeing Master, who was just leaving with his [[Yoda's fighter/Legends|starfighter]] and Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="Voices" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:RigNema-Voices.png|thumb|left|180px|Jedi physician, Rig Nema]]
{{Quote|I would like to suggest something: a deprivation ritual. It is a dangerous procedure, but one that will without question allow Yoda to go to the source of this voice whatever, whoever it may be.|Doctor Rig Nema|<ref name="Voices" />}}
Jedi Doctor Rig Nema was a humanoid female with [[Color/Legends|golden]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and yellow skin. She proved to be competent and meticulous, always checking Master Yoda's vital signs and making reports on his health to the rest of the Jedi Council.<ref name="Voices" />

She did not hesitate to suggest dangerous methods, such as the deprivation ritual, in order to help her patient. Strict and professional, Nema did not want to interrupt the procedure before it had been completed, even when the situation became critical for Yoda's life.<ref name="Voices" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Jedi, Nema was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and carried a green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="ExpTCWTLO">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep610|text="The Lost One" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref> She also was skilled in medicine, serving the Order as a doctor.<ref name="Voices" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnknownDarkSiderAdept.jpg|thumb|right|170px|Concept art of Mace Windu for Episode I]]
Rig Nema first appeared in "[[Voices]]," the eleventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|final season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. She was voiced by [[Catherine Taber]], who also portrayed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in the series.<ref name="Voices" />

Nema's appearance is based on an early concept design of Mace Windu from the pre-production of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="ExpTCWV">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep611|text="Voices" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> It was drawn by [[Iain McCaig]].<ref name="TAoTPM">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace]]''</ref>
